tables.label: Table 4
tables.caption: Checkerboard assay of antibiotics and antimicrobial peptides against M. smegmatis. Rifampicin/polymyxin B and ATRA-1A/LL-37/mCRAMP. Synergy is defined as FICI ≤ 0.5, 0.5 < FICI ≤ 1.0 as additive, 1.0 < FICI ≤ 4.0 as indifferent, and FICI > 4.0 as antagonism [25]. Synergism was observed for several of the peptide drug combinations (shaded). Experiments were performed in triplicate (n = 6). Means ± the SD are shown; p ≤ 0.001.
